name: Verifone BlueCommerce for WooCommerce
author: Verifone Finland

sections.description:
BlueCommerce is a domestic online payment service provider backed by Verifone’s extensive experience in payment solutions. Designed to meet the needs of businesses of all sizes, BlueCommerce enables seamless payment management for both e-commerce and in-stores within a single system.

Thanks to Verifone’s solid expertise, BlueCommerce offers a wide range of payment methods, including bank buttons, credit and debit cards, and mobile payments for your WooCommerce store. Additionally, we continuously improve our service and ensure compatibility with the latest WordPress and WooCommerce versions.

Wide Range of Payment Methods:

  • Bank Buttons – BlueCommerce provides the most popular bank payment options, including Nordea, OP, Danske Bank, S-Pankki, Aktia, Oma Säästöpankki, and many more. Visit our website for the full list.
  • Credit and Debit Cards – The most comprehensive card payment selection, including Visa, MasterCard, PayPal, Eurocard, American Express, and Diners Club.
  • Mobile Payment Methods – MobilePay, Apple Pay.
  • Invoice and Installment Payment Options – OP Invoice, Svea.

Key Features:

  • Reliability and Performance – Trusted by businesses that demand absolute operational reliability, such as ABC Mobile, Alko, and Verkkokauppa.com.
  • The Fastest Settlement Time on the Market – Funds are transferred quickly and transparently directly to your account.
  • Mobile-Optimized Payment Pages – BlueCommerce service is fully functional on all mobile devices, improving conversion rates and reducing abandoned transactions.
  • Local Customer Support – Fast and professional assistance via phone and email.
  • Easy Setup – Quick installation with the WooCommerce plugin and seamless integration into your WooCommerce store.
  • Reporting and Transaction Monitoring – Access Verifone’s dedicated reporting tool, providing a clear overview of your payment flow. This tool allows you to manage and review payments from both physical stores and online shops in one place. Visit our website for more information.
  • Security – Verifone is a financial institution licensed by the Financial Supervisory Authority, and all our payment services comply with PCI requirements.
  • Integration of Physical and Online Stores – Enables unified payment management within a single system.

To use the online payment service, you must have an active BlueCommerce agreement. If you do not have an agreement with us yet, you can find our contact information on our website or submit a contact request form to get started.

In order for the payment gateway to work, orders and necessary client information is sent to Verifone’s servers when order is placed using BlueCommerce payment method. Read more about our data handling practices on our website.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Verifone BlueCommerce for WooCommerce” or click Upload Plugin to upload the ZIP file.
  3. Click Install Now, then activate the plugin.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  5. Enable “Verifone BlueCommerce” and click Manage to configure the settings.

2.0.0

Release date: X

Major release as plugin name, slug and delivery method are changed. From this version onwards, plugin will be distributed via WordPress.org plugin repository.

Functionalities of this new version will not be used if there’s earlier versions of the plugin installed.

Added

  • Debugging information to Site Health
  • Visible notices to dashboard in case of configuration errors
  • Automatic update of available payment methods daily
  • Automatic communications key generation on plugin activation if keys don’t exists already
  • OP Lasku payment method
  • IP allowlist message to payment service redirect when using test environment
  • Method to reset all plugin settings

Changed

  • Plugin slug, affects also translations
  • Complete overhaul of settings page, making it more clear and separating advanced settings
  • Payment logos as an default method of presentation in new installations
  • Updated list of payment methods

Fixed

  • Edge cases where orders with gift cards are not accepted by payment service
  • Payment method loading to be executed correctly in order to have full compatibility with translations and other gateway plugins
  • Configuration summary modal styles on smaller viewports

Removed

  • Unnecessary admin ajax endpoints
